browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium from node_modules/.pnpm, headless, 1440x900, one isolated browser context per identity

fixturePreparation.text: Jonas Weber submitted four Legal question Requests through the Portal API (R-43, R-44, R-45, R-46). Daniel Okafor converted R-43 to Contract C-45, R-44 to Matter M-59, and R-46 to Contract C-46 through the convert API; R-45 stays unconverted. Daniel added Nadia Haddad to the C-45 and M-59 teams through the team API. The Request submission and conversion procedures belong to other guides.
Daniel Okafor posted 55 Matter Team comments and one Legal Only comment on M-59 through the comments API, to give the Matter more than one page of comments, History entries, and notifications.
Daniel Okafor archived C-46 through the archive API after posting a Contract Team comment with paper in the browser.
Daniel Okafor added Amara Nwosu (Business User) to the C-45 team through the team API, then removed her again; later removed and restored Jonas Weber the same way.
Nadia Haddad posted one working_team comment on C-45 and one on R-45 through the comments API to stand in for older Working Team comments; the composer does not offer that tier.

steps.step: Choose an audience on a record: open the Contract, select Comments, read the audience options and descriptions
steps.expected: Legal Only and Contract Team offered, Contract Team selected first, description below the composer changes with the choice
steps.actual: C-45 Comments applet opened from the Applets toolbar. Audience offered "Audience Legal Only Contract Team" with Contract Team checked first. Description read "Visible to Legal and all Contract team members." for Contract Team and "Visible to Administrators and Legal Team Members." for Legal Only. No Internal team option was offered.

steps.step: Post one Legal Only and one Contract Team comment on the Contract and check name and audience badge
steps.expected: Each post appears under Nadia Haddad with its audience badge
steps.actual: Rows read "NH Nadia Haddad Legal Only this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia legal only note" and "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia contract team note".

steps.step: Choose an audience on a Matter: Matter Team first, Legal Only available, post both
steps.expected: Matter Team is the starting audience and posts carry Matter Team or Legal Only badges
steps.actual: M-59 Audience offered "Audience Legal Only Matter Team", Matter Team checked first, description "Visible to Legal and all Matter team members.". Rows read "NH Nadia Haddad Matter Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia matter team note" and "NH Nadia Haddad Legal Only this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia matter legal only note".

steps.step: Mention a person: type @ and part of a name, pick on the People tab, check Mentioned, Remove, pick again, Comment
steps.expected: People tab lists reachable people, Files tab present for Legal, Mentioned list with Remove, post succeeds
steps.actual: Typing @Dan opened the tabs ["People","Files"] with People selected, listing ["DO\nDaniel Okafor"]. Choosing Daniel Okafor added "Daniel Okafor" to the Mentioned list; Remove Daniel Okafor emptied it (0 lists left). After re-picking, Comment posted "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia asks @Daniel Okafor to check the notice letter." at Contract Team without a widen prompt.

steps.step: Typing a name as ordinary text alone does not select a recipient
steps.expected: No Mentioned list when the name is typed without choosing from the list
steps.actual: Typing "Daniel Okafor" without @ and without choosing showed no Mentioned list; the draft was cleared unposted.

steps.step: Widen the audience? on a Legal Only mention of a Business User: Cancel keeps editing without posting, Widen and post posts at the proposed audience
steps.expected: Dialog names the proposed audience; Cancel posts nothing; Widen and post posts at Contract Team
steps.actual: Dialog read "Widen the audience? Jonas Weber cannot see a legal only comment. Post it at contract team instead to reach them. Visible to Legal and all Contract team members. Cancel Widen and post". Cancel closed it, kept the draft "DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia legal only mention for @Jonas Weber ", and no row was posted. Widen and post published "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia legal only mention for @Jonas Weber".

steps.step: Attach paper: Attach files, choose files, check filenames, Remove one, post, open the preview and use Download
steps.expected: Selected filenames listed with Remove; post carries the remaining attachment; preview opens; Download retrieves the file
steps.actual: Composer read "Up to 5 files.". Choosing two PDFs listed "doc029-conv-notice.pdf doc029-conv-schedule.pdf"; Remove doc029-conv-schedule.pdf left "doc029-conv-notice.pdf". Audience line before posting: "Visible to Legal and all Contract team members.". Posted row "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia shares the notice letter doc029-conv-notice.pdf File to Contract". Selecting the filename opened a preview dialog ("doc029-conv-notice.pdf Page 1 of 1 100% DOC-029 conversations fictional notice letter Download File to Contract", buttons ["","","","","","","File to Contract"], links ["Download"]). Download doc029-conv-notice.pdf saved doc029-conv-notice.pdf with bytes identical to the fixture.

steps.step: A failed post: keep the draft, check the error, check for an existing post, retry once
steps.expected: Error shown; text and paper stay in the composer; no row posted and no filed marker; retry posts exactly once
steps.actual: With the comment POST aborted once, the composer showed "The comment could not be posted. Try again.", kept the text "DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia retry after a failed post" and the paper "doc029-conv-schedule.pdf"; no row was posted and 0 Filed to markers were shown. A reload to check for an existing post found 0 rows. Re-entering the draft and retrying posted exactly 1 row with the attachment.

steps.step: File to Contract on an unfiled attachment: the preview also offers it; file as a new Document; the attachment stays and shows Filed to
steps.expected: File to Contract offered on the attachment and in the preview; after filing the thread row shows Filed to with Document and version; the Document is on the record
steps.actual: The preview offered File to Contract (1). The row's File to Contract opened File attachment with Destination options ["New Document","New Version on an existing Document"]. Filing as a New Document named "DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 filed notice letter" closed the dialog; the thread row still lists doc029-conv-notice.pdf and shows "Filed to DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 filed notice letter, version 1", with 0 File to Contract controls left on it. The record's Documents read includes the new Document (HTTP 200).

steps.step: Edit or remove a post: Edit then Cancel, Edit then Save shows edited, Delete asks for confirmation and leaves the author tombstone; no Redact for a Legal Team Member
steps.expected: Cancel leaves text; Save marks edited; edit box has no audience control; Delete confirmation then Comment deleted by its author.; menu has Edit and Delete only
steps.actual: Comment actions on her own comment offered ["Edit","Delete"]. Edit opened Edit comment with 0 audience radios; Cancel left "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia wording to correct". Save left "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team edited this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia wording to correct corrected". Delete asked "Delete this comment? A tombstone keeps its place in the thread, and nobody can read what it said. You cannot undo this. Cancel Delete"; confirming left Comment deleted by its author. and 0 rows with the text.

steps.step: Show older and the unread Comments badge on a Matter with more comments than one page
steps.expected: Badge counts unread comments she can see; Show older loads earlier comments; reading the loaded conversation updates the count
steps.actual: Before opening, the Comments applet button read "56" (unread read {"unread":56}). The first load listed 50 rows with Show older at the head; Show older brought the list to 58 rows including bulk update 01. After reading, the button read "" (unread read {"unread":0}).

steps.step: Read the Activity feed: History on the Matter, entries in order, Show older
steps.expected: History lists actions on the record, including comment actions, with Show older for earlier changes
steps.actual: History listed 25 entries, first "Daniel Okafor commented this minute". Show older brought 50 entries; the last reads "Daniel Okafor commented this minute".

steps.step: Choose an audience in the Inbox: a Request offers Legal only and Shared with requester, starting on Legal only; the Inbox Request has no History
steps.expected: Two audiences, Legal only first, descriptions shown; posts carry their audience; no History applet
steps.actual: R-45 Applets toolbar offered ["Comments"]. Audience offered "Audience Legal only Shared with requester" with Legal only checked; descriptions "Visible to Administrators and Legal Team Members." and "Visible to Legal and the requester.". Posted rows "NH Nadia Haddad Shared with requester this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia shared reply on the open Request" and "NH Nadia Haddad Legal only this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia legal only Request note".

steps.step: A converted Request in the Inbox has no conversation; open its linked record instead
steps.expected: No Comments applet on the converted Request; Status links the Contract
steps.actual: R-43 in the Inbox showed 0 applet buttons and a Status link C-45 (/contracts/45); selecting it opened the Contract.

steps.step: Choose an audience on a record and post at both audiences, one with Legal Only paper
steps.expected: Legal Only and Contract Team offered; posts show under Daniel Okafor with their badges and attachment
steps.actual: Audience offered "Audience Legal Only Contract Team", Contract Team first (true). Rows "DO Daniel Okafor Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Daniel owner note" and "DO Daniel Okafor Legal Only this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Daniel legal only memo doc029-conv-legal-memo.pdf File to Contract".

steps.step: Another author's comment: Comment actions offers Redact and no Edit
steps.expected: Menu on Nadia's live comment offers Redact only
steps.actual: Comment actions on Nadia Haddad's Contract Team comment offered ["Redact"].

steps.step: File to Matter on a Matter conversation attachment
steps.expected: A Matter Team post with paper offers File to Matter
steps.actual: The Matter Team row "DO Daniel Okafor Matter Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Daniel matter paper doc029-conv-schedule.pdf File to Matter" offered File to Matter; it opened File attachment with ["New Document","New Version on an existing Document"]; Cancel closed it with 0 Filed to markers.

steps.step: Legal Request conversation: Comment actions on his own live comment edits and deletes; no File control on Request paper
steps.expected: Edit then Save shows edited; Delete confirmation leaves the author tombstone; Request attachment has no File to control
steps.actual: On R-45 his Shared with requester post with paper showed 0 File controls. His menu offered ["Edit","Delete","Redact"]; Save left "DO Daniel Okafor Shared with requester edited this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Daniel request paper revised doc029-conv-schedule.pdf". Deleting a Legal only note after the confirmation left 1 Comment deleted by its author. tombstones and no row with its text.

steps.step: Reply from the Portal on a never-converted Request: Comments applet, no audience picker, Legal only comments absent, mention and attach, Comment
steps.expected: Shared with requester reply visible, Legal only note absent, reply posts under Jonas Weber with paper
steps.actual: R-45 Portal Comments showed 0 audience radios, 1 Shared with requester reply from Nadia, and 0 rows of her Legal only note. @Nad showed tabs ["People"] listing ["NH\nNadia Haddad"]; after picking Nadia Haddad and attaching doc029-conv-portal-note.pdf, Comment posted "JW Jonas Weber Shared with requester this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Jonas replies on the open Request for @Nadia Haddad doc029-conv-portal-note.pdf".

steps.step: Portal: Comment actions edits and deletes his own words
steps.expected: Edit and Delete offered on his own comment, no Redact; edited marker; author tombstone
steps.actual: His menu offered ["Edit","Delete"]; Save left "JW Jonas Weber Shared with requester edited this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Jonas second thought revised"; Delete after confirmation left Comment deleted by its author.; Nadia's reply had 0 Comment actions buttons.

steps.step: After conversion the Request address opens the Contract; its Comments hold team comments and their paper but no Legal Only content, no filing, no audience picker
steps.expected: Redirect to the Portal Contract; Contract Team rows and widened mention visible; Legal Only rows and memo absent; attachment preview and Download work; no File to Contract
steps.actual: /portal/requests/43 redirected to /portal/contracts/45. Comments counts {"team":1,"widened":1,"notice":1,"danielTeam":1,"legalOnly":0,"danielMemo":0,"memoFile":0}; 0 audience radios; 0 File to controls; the notice letter downloaded with fixture-identical bytes. Its row read "NH Nadia Haddad Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Nadia shares the notice letter doc029-conv-notice.pdf Filed to DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 filed notice letter, version 1".

steps.step: Portal Matter: Show older and the unread badge; Legal Only bulk note absent
steps.expected: Show older loads the earlier Matter Team comments; the Legal Only note is not in the view
steps.actual: Before opening, the Portal Comments button read "57". Show older loaded bulk update 01; Nadia's Matter Team note was present; Legal Only notes from Daniel and Nadia were absent (0, 0).

steps.step: Portal History on the Contract: shared comment activity only
steps.expected: History shows comment entries for team comments only; no Legal Only activity
steps.actual: Portal History listed 9 entries: ["Daniel Okafor commented this minute","Nadia Haddad deleted a comment this minute","Nadia Haddad changed a comment this minute","Nadia Haddad commented this minute","Nadia Haddad commented this minute","Nadia Haddad commented this minute","Nadia Haddad commented this minute","Nadia Haddad commented this minute","Nadia Haddad commented this minute"]. Staff activity read for comparison: "{\"entries\":[{\"id\":\"01a0ab59-a30c-709a-aa97-ab47404c92b4\",\"action\":\"comment.posted\",\"visibility\":\"legal_only\",\"actor\":{\"id\":\"01a0ab53-0e0b-7225-9d4d-2a29904eac73\",\"displayName\":\"Daniel Okafor\",\"image\":".

steps.step: Redact a reached comment with paper, an author-deleted comment, and the comment whose attachment was filed
steps.expected: Confirmation read first; thread says Comment removed by an Administrator.; attachment URL no longer serves; the filed Document stays on the record
steps.actual: Redact on Nadia's comment with paper asked "Redact this comment? The text and every earlier version of it are removed for good. Use this for text posted into the wrong record. You cannot undo this. Cancel Redact". After confirming, the row became Comment removed by an Administrator. and its attachment URL answered 404 (it answered 200 before). On her author-deleted comment the menu offered ["Redact"] and the redaction replaced that tombstone. Redacting the notice-letter comment left the filed Document on the record (true). The thread now shows 3 administrator tombstones and 0 author tombstones.

steps.step: Archived record: the attachment offers no File to Contract
steps.expected: No File to Contract on an archived Contract
steps.actual: Before archiving, the row offered File to Contract (1). After archiving C-46, the same row showed 0 File to controls: "DO Daniel Okafor Contract Team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 Daniel archive paper doc029-conv-schedule.pdf".

steps.step: Archived destination: the Request address shows the original request with no conversation
steps.expected: Portal Request page shows the archived message and no Comments
steps.actual: The archived Contract C-46 record read answered HTTP 404 for Jonas. /portal/requests/46 stayed at /portal/requests/46, showed "The record created from this Request was archived. Your original request is shown below.", and had 0 applet toolbars and 0 Comments buttons.

steps.step: A later-added Business User reads earlier team comments; a removed person loses them, including through the old Request link
steps.expected: Amara sees earlier Contract Team comments after being added; after removal Jonas cannot open the Contract or its conversation through /portal/requests
steps.actual: After being added, Amara Nwosu saw Nadia's earlier Contract Team note (1) and not her Legal Only note (0). After removal Amara's Portal Contract page read "Your Contracts Contract not found This Contract does not exist, or you cannot open it." (record read HTTP 404). After Jonas's removal, /portal/requests/43 showed "What do you need from Legal? Help with this page NDA request Estimated turnaround: 3 business days Mutual or one-way NDA with a counterparty. Contract review Estimated turnaround: 7 business days Revi" with 0 Comments buttons (record read HTTP 404). Jonas was restored to the team (HTTP 201).

steps.step: Internal team: an older Working Team comment stays readable to Legal with its label, cannot be chosen, and stays out of the Business User view
steps.expected: Contract shows Internal team badge; Inbox Request shows Working team badge; no such composer option; Jonas sees neither
steps.actual: Nadia's Contract row read "NH Nadia Haddad Internal team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 older working team note" with composer options "Audience Legal Only Contract Team". Her Inbox Request row read "NH Nadia Haddad Working team this minute DOC-029r2 conversations 135085 older working team request note" with options "Audience Legal only Shared with requester". Jonas's Portal Contract showed 0 and Portal Request 0 of these comments.

steps.step: If the conversation or History cannot load: follow the message to reopen; retry Show older when only the earlier page failed
steps.expected: The conversation could not be read. Reopen the panel to try again.; reopening recovers; The earlier comments could not be read. Try again. keeps loaded rows and the retry loads more; The history could not be read. Reopen the panel to try again.
steps.actual: A blocked thread read showed "The conversation could not be read. Reopen the panel to try again."; closing and reopening Comments loaded 51 rows. A blocked earlier page showed "The earlier comments could not be read. Try again." with 51 rows kept; the retry brought 60. A blocked History read showed "The history could not be read. Reopen the panel to try again."; reopening listed 25 entries.

steps.step: Attach files accepts up to five files
steps.expected: Choosing six files keeps at most five in the list
steps.actual: Choosing six text files listed 5 files (alerts []; Attach files disabled: true). The draft was discarded unposted.
